reasoning_summary:
2.2.1-2 avaris taken with terris (greedy earth); lamnae glossed as bullion; 2.2.9-12 regnes/iungas/serviat kept as potential subjunctives; 2.2.23-24 ingentis ... acervos left split.
2.3.9 quo kept (variant qua noted); 2.3.18 flavos read as old nominative of flavus with Tiberis; 2.3.19-20 potior + ablative left in Latin order with note.
2.4.17-19 crede non ... potuisse: non left where it stands, noted as negating potuisse; 2.4.23-24 eighth lustrum = fortieth year.
2.5 extended heifer/grape metaphors kept literal and glossed; long hyperbata (virentis ... campos, proterva ... fronte, pura ... luna) left split with agreement notes; 2.5.17 quantum non kept as 'as much as not'.
2.6.11-12 regnata ... Laconi ... Phalantho split as in the Latin; 2.6.19-20 minimum invidet glossed as 'hardly inferior'.
2.7.25 Venus = the dice-throw choosing the master of drinking; 2.7.27-28 recepto ... amico ablative absolute split over the line break.
2.8.9-12 oath by mother's ashes, night sky and gods kept as accusatives of fallere with notes; aura and iuvencis metaphors glossed.
2.9.17 desine + genitive noted; 2.9.19-20 Augusti ... Caesaris split; 2.10.11-12 subject fulgura after verb, noted to prevent subject/object misreading.
